{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue and remove QA orders
completed_only['revenue_numeric'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
valid_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment'])
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', cross_tab)

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
conversion_by_segment = valid_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print('\nConversion rates by channel and segment:\n', conversion_by_segment)

# Compute segment-wise differences
# email - paid_search within each segment
segment_diffs = conversion_by_segment['email'] - conversion_by_segment['paid_search']
print('\nDifference (email - paid_search) by segment:\n', segment_diffs)"}
